title: Cleararc Capital Inc. Has $24.22 Million Position in Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Cleararc Capital Inc. lowered its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2.7% during the 2nd its most recent filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The fund owned 130,833 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 3,657 shares during the period. Apple accounts for about 3.4% of Cleararc Capital Inc.’s holdings, making the stock its largest holding. Cleararc Capital Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $24,218,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission.
Several other institutional investors also recently bought and sold shares of AAPL. Summit Trail Advisors LLC boosted its stake in Apple by 17,669.4% during the 1st quarter. Summit Trail Advisors LLC now owns 20,180,694 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $20,181,000 after purchasing an additional 20,067,124 shares during the last quarter. Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Holdings Inc. boosted its stake in Apple by 6.5% during the 2nd quarter. Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Holdings Inc. now owns 17,008,496 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $3,148,443,000 after purchasing an additional 1,030,981 shares during the last quarter. Swiss National Bank boosted its stake in Apple by 1.8% during the 2nd quarter. Swiss National Bank now owns 16,874,216 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $3,123,586,000 after purchasing an additional 304,600 shares during the last quarter. Cornerstone Wealth Management LLC boosted its stake in Apple by 18,553.3% during the 2nd quarter. Cornerstone Wealth Management LLC now owns 16,758,709 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $89,526,000 after purchasing an additional 16,668,866 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Dimensional Fund Advisors LP boosted its stake in Apple by 0.3% during the 1st quarter. Dimensional Fund Advisors LP now owns 16,158,094 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,711,005,000 after purchasing an additional 55,050 shares during the last quarter. Institutional investors own 57.10% of the company’s stock.
